features.name: ordinal_block1_level_norm
features.description: Normalized average level of the first ordinal block a1-a5 on the observed 1-to-5 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth low-dimensional level signal that linear SVM margins can weight instead of relying only on five separate ordinal inputs.

features.name: ordinal_block2_level_norm
features.description: Normalized average level of the second ordinal block a6-a10 on the observed 1-to-5 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a second smooth ordinal level axis, useful when the two ordinal blocks carry different row structure.

features.name: ordinal_level_gap_norm
features.description: Signed normalized difference between the second and first ordinal block levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a direct contrast feature for rows where relative block elevation is more informative than absolute level.

features.name: ordinal_ramp_projection
features.description: Weighted left-to-right ramp projection across both ordinal blocks, emphasizing low-index versus high-index positions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates an interpretable linear trend direction that a linear SVM can use as a compact shape coordinate.

features.name: ordinal_pair_mismatch_norm
features.description: Mean absolute paired disagreement between a1-a5 and a6-a10 after aligning positions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes cross-block consistency as a continuous severity measure that can improve margin placement.

features.name: continuous_block1_log_level_norm
features.description: Log-compressed average magnitude of continuous block a11-a15, normalized by the training-fold upper range for that block.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed magnitudes into a smooth level score suited to linear SVM scaling.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(a11) + np.log1p(a12) + np.log1p(a13) + np.log1p(a14) + np.log1p(a15)) / (5.0 * np.log1p(39.675)), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: continuous_block2_log_level_norm
features.description: Log-compressed average magnitude of continuous block a16-a20, normalized by the training-fold upper range for that block.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a comparable smooth continuous-level axis for the second continuous block.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(a16) + np.log1p(a17) + np.log1p(a18) + np.log1p(a19) + np.log1p(a20)) / (5.0 * np.log1p(39.448)), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: continuous_log_level_gap_norm
features.description: Signed difference between log-compressed continuous block levels for a16-a20 and a11-a15.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a normalized contrast between continuous blocks, reducing the need for the SVM to infer this difference from many raw inputs.
features.formula: np.clip(((np.log1p(a16) + np.log1p(a17) + np.log1p(a18) + np.log1p(a19) + np.log1p(a20)) / (5.0 * np.log1p(39.448))) - ((np.log1p(a11) + np.log1p(a12) + np.log1p(a13) + np.log1p(a14) + np.log1p(a15)) / (5.0 * np.log1p(39.675))), -1.0, 1.0)

features.name: continuous_pair_log_mismatch_norm
features.description: Mean absolute paired disagreement between log-compressed continuous blocks after aligning positions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts paired continuous discrepancies into one smooth severity coordinate for margin-based separation.
features.formula: np.clip((np.abs(np.log1p(a11) - np.log1p(a16)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a12) - np.log1p(a17)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a13) - np.log1p(a18)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a14) - np.log1p(a19)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a15) - np.log1p(a20))) / (5.0 * np.log1p(40.0)), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: continuous_endpoint_log_share
features.description: Share of total log-compressed continuous magnitude concentrated in endpoint columns a15 and a20.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable ratio for endpoint concentration, helpful when tail-heavy rows form a near-linear pattern.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(a15) + np.log1p(a20)) / (np.log1p(a11) + np.log1p(a12) + np.log1p(a13) + np.log1p(a14) + np.log1p(a15) + np.log1p(a16) + np.log1p(a17) + np.log1p(a18) + np.log1p(a19) + np.log1p(a20) + 0.000001), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: profile_shape_coherence_score
features.description: Numeric semantic review of the row shape across the two ordinal runs and two continuous runs. Score 1 means smooth, internally consistent progression with similar paired blocks; score 0 means strong reversals, broken ordering, or mismatched paired blocks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures soft shape regularities not fully represented by algebraic summaries, adding a near-linear cue for SVM margins.

features.name: heavy_tail_salience_score
features.description: Numeric semantic review of unusual large continuous values among a11-a20, considering both multiple high values and isolated spikes relative to the fixed training-fold ranges. Score 0 means none are notable; score 1 means severe row-wide or spike-like extremes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a single severity axis for rare large-magnitude patterns, helping a linear SVM use heavy-tail intensity without many sparse extreme indicators.
